title: Adequate moduli space
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $\mathcal X$ be an algebraic stack over $\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-sfb-algebraic-moduli-stack, def-weil-affine-spectrum], let $Y$ be an algebraic space over $k$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $\phi:\mathcal X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact, quasi-separated morphism in the conventions of [def-sfb-stack-qcqs-morphism]. The morphism $\phi$ is an adequate moduli space if both of the following conditions hold. (1) The canonical map $\mathcal O_Y\to\phi_*\mathcal O_{\mathcal X}$ is an isomorphism, with the structure sheaves and direct image as in [def-sfb-stack-quasi-coherent-algebra]. (2) For every etale morphism $v:W=\operatorname{Spec}C\to Y$ from an affine scheme, form $\mathcal X_W=\mathcal X\times_YW$ as a $2$-fibre product [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. For every surjection $\mathcal A\twoheadrightarrow\mathcal B$ of quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_{\mathcal X_W}$-algebras [def-sfb-stack-quasi-coherent-algebra] and every $t\in\Gamma(\mathcal X_W,\mathcal B)$, there are an integer $N>0$ and $s\in\Gamma(\mathcal X_W,\mathcal A)$ whose image is $t^N$. All quasi-coherent algebras on $\mathcal X_W$ are quantified over, including those that do not descend from $\mathcal X$. Etaleness of maps to $Y$ is tested after etale scheme charts on $Y$ using [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Condition (2) is the local power-lifting condition; it does not replace condition (1). No exactness of $\phi_*$ is imposed.

There is a new node, def-sfb-stack-qcqs-morphism. The item's mathematics is unchanged and correct against Alper arXiv:1005.2398v3: Def 5.1.1 keeps (1) separate, and Def 4.1.1, Lemma 4.1.8(3), Rem 4.1.3 and Prop 4.2.1(3),(4) give lifting on all algebras on X_W. Dropping 'equivalently adequately affine' is right: Spec k[z]→Spec k is a counterexample. The edge cases (identity, BG with G linearly reductive, empty source or target) behave correctly. The qcqs node matches Stacks 050U, 04YC(3), 03HE, 03HL(3) and 04YW(4). Repair 1 (B3/E1), def-sfb-stack-quasi-coherent-algebra: it took an algebraic stack as input but is applied to X_W = X×_Y W, whose algebraicity is 04TF and not a node; lem-sfb-algebraic-stack-fibre-products needs Y to be an algebraic stack. I re-applied the widening to categories fibred in groupoids from the earlier heads, which has now been lost four times; the Stacks sections 06TP/06TV/06WG/06W6 are stated in that generality. Repair 2 (B3/E1), def-sfb-stack-qcqs-morphism: the stack and space qc predicates were applied to 2-fibre products and to a target that is an algebraic space, and representability of Δ_f (04XS) was presupposed. I stated the predicates for any fibred groupoid or fppf sheaf, since every atlas notion is already defined for arbitrary F, and made representability of the diagonal an explicit conjunct of quasi-separatedness. Neither repair weakens anything on algebraic stacks. Batch-5 flags (algebraic-moduli-stack, stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids, def-trf-algebraic-space, def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module): all are general definitions. Their trf closure is projective-bundle and Proj geometry, not trace-formula or Poincaré-duality content, so I accept them. There is no cycle, no duplicate and no SGA citation.
